REPORT ON Communist Activities.

Made by and Forwarded by R.W. Yorke, A/A.C.P. (Pol.)

Further to my report of April 18 attached herewith.
Yui Wong Sz (Mrs. Yu Yeu Dzung) appeared before the
Provisional Court (Judge Liang Lone and Mr. Whitamore, S.C.D.)
in chambers on April 18 charged under Art. 221 of the C.P.C. Code.
She emphatically denied any knowledge of the Communist orders,
etc. found in possession of the male accused Tsang Pau Dzien
and further stated that she did not even know the man. Mrs. Yui
was released on the personal bond of Mr. Tseng Yung(曾鏞),
Chief of the Anti-Opium Bureau.

On April 19, the two accused again appeared before
open Court (Judge Liang Lone and Mr. Stevens). Tsang Pau Dzien
adhered strictly to his former statement, whilst Mrs. Yui denied
all knowledge of him or the documents seized.

Captain Yih Liang Kwang(葉亮光), an Adjutant attached
to the Defence Commissioner's Yamen, presented a despatch
requesting the Court to hand both accused over to the Military
Authorities. The Court decided, however, to discharge the
female accused and ordered that the male accused be handed over
to the Shanghai District Court.

The handing over of a prisoner to the Shanghai District
Court on a warrant issued by the Defence Commissioner is unprece-
dented, and such action can only be interpreted as a compromise
in view of the accused persons being related to Mr. Yu Yeu Dzung.

The translation marked X is a letter referring to the
arrest of Loo Yih Noong(羅亦農) on April 15 (mentioned as
"brother Nung" in the translation).

余王氏（Yui Wong Sz，即余耀宗之妻 Yu Yeu Dzung）于4月18日在密室出庭受审（法官为梁龙法官和惠特莫尔先生 Mr. Whitamore，特别巡捕房 S.C.D.），被控违反《刑事诉讼法典》第221条。她坚决否认知晓在男被告曾宝珍（Tsang Pau Dzien）身上搜出的共产党命令等文件，并进一步声称她甚至不认识此人。余女士由禁烟局局长曾鏞先生（Mr. Tseng Yung）具保释放。

4月19日，两名被告再次在公开法庭出庭（法官为梁龙法官和史蒂文斯先生 Mr. Stevens）。曾宝珍严格坚持其先前陈述，而余女士则否认认识他或知晓被搜获的文件。

隶属于防卫委员公署的副官叶亮光上尉（Captain Yih Liang Kwang）提交了一份公文，请求法庭将两名被告移交给军事当局。然而，法庭决定释放女被告，并命令将男被告移交给上海地方法院。

依据防卫委员签发的搜查令将囚犯移交给上海地方法院是前所未有的，鉴于被告人与余耀宗先生有关联，此举只能被解释为一种妥协。

Nov. 22.

Brother Ching Wen (景 文 ),

When I left, you were studying in school, and as
I was only given three hours' notice of my departure, I
could not say farewell to you. I arrived here "Wei"
(? Vladivostock ) about one week ago. The reason why
I stayed here for the past week was because we were told
that we had to submit ourselves to physical examination
which, however, was not held. Consequently we decided to
continue our journey to-day, 22nd. But to-day we have
again postponed over departure, because to-day's train is
not a through train, so we will go either tomorrow or
the day after.

I am extremely pleased at hearing the news about
Canton. I thought I would come back at once and do my
part. I thought again and again and finally formed the
opinion that in the beginning of a people's uprising, it
is not always sure of a success, but after repeated
uprisings, the experience gained from them will lead to
the final success. We are reserves for the future, so
though ambitions to come back at this moment, we cannot
possibly return. Therefore I decided to proceed on my
journey and to study. While I am away in a distant country,
I hope you, who are doing "internal work", will double
your efforts in training our "low grade" comrades. A
Clever man as you are, you must have a good record. In
future, during your leisure time, I hope you will frequently
write to me and tell me all the news you can. Address the
letters c/o brother Ching Vung. (泾 文 ).

The place of my study will probably be Leningrad which
Is a prosperous, rich and civilized city in this country. It
is like Shanghai.

Please deliver the enclosed letters to the Principal
of the school, my brother and wife.

With best regards to you, aunt and elder sister,
(Sd.) Chun ( 均 ).

11月22日。

景文兄：

我离开时，你正在学校读书，由于我只提前三小时得知出发消息，未能向你告别。我于一周前抵达此地“威”（? 符拉迪沃斯托克/海参崴）。过去一周我滞留此地的原因是，我们被告知必须接受体检，但体检并未举行。因此，我们决定今天，即22日，继续行程。但今天我们又推迟了出发，因为今天的列车不是直达列车，所以我们将于明天或后天出发。

听到关于广州的消息，我感到非常高兴。我曾想立刻回来尽我的本分。我反复思考，最终形成了一种观点，即在人民起义的初期，成功并非总是确定的，但经过多次起义，从中获得的经验将导向最终的成功。我们是未来的后备力量，所以虽然此刻渴望回来，但我们不可能返回。因此，我决定继续我的旅程并学习。当我身在异国他乡时，我希望从事“内部工作”的你，加倍努力训练我们的“低级”同志。像你这样聪明的人，一定会有良好的表现。将来，在你的闲暇时间，我希望你能经常给我写信，告诉我所有你能得到的消息。信件请寄给泾文兄（Ching Vung）转交。

我就读的地方可能是列宁格勒，那是这个国家一个繁荣、富裕且文明的城市。它就像上海一样。

请将随信附上的信件交给学校校长、我的兄弟和妻子。

向你、阿姨和姐姐致以最好的问候，
（签名）均（Chun）。

Sir,

At 2.15 p.m. April 16, a Chinese cook named Lee Zung Sung (李顺生) reported at Gordon Road Station that his employers residing at No.958 Dzien Lok Li (全乐里), Connaught Road, had absconded and as they were armed with pistols, he suspected unlawful activities.

Detectives visited the address given, a modern Chinese house, and in all of the six rooms, found disorder and every sign of a hurried departure. It was subsequently learned from the cook that the house had been rented for about two months by two families, apparently inter-related. named Tseu (周) and Dzien (钱). In all, there were three male and four female occupants of the house, and in addition the cook and an amah.

The occupants spent their time at home in close conversation with numerous and frequent visitors.

At 12.30 p.m. on April 16, while five of the seven occupants were engaged at their mid-day meal, a Chinese in foreign dress, aged about 30 years, rushed into the house in an extremely agitated voice shouted "Phoo-teh ! phoo-teh ! (破脱discovered)". The occupants, leaving their meal unfinished, rushed about the house gathering up clothes, and two of the males were seen by the cook to wrap several packets of banknotes in newspaper and each put a pistol in his pocket. The cook, upon asking for his wages, was told to wait a few days. One of his male employers then drew his pistol and brandishing it in the face of the cook, forbade him to report

4月16日下午2时15分，一名名叫李顺生（Lee Zung Sung）的中国厨子前往戈登路捕房报案，称其雇主居住在康纳脱路全乐里958号，已潜逃，且因他们持有手枪，他怀疑其从事非法活动。

侦探前往上述地址，那是一幢现代化的中式住宅，在所有六个房间内均发现杂乱无章的迹象，以及匆忙离去的各种痕迹。随后从厨子处获悉，该房屋已由两个 apparently 有亲属关系的家庭租用约两个月，姓周（Tseu）和姓钱（Dzien）。屋内共有三名男性和四名女性居住者，此外还有一名厨子和一名女佣。

居住者在家中与众多且频繁来访的客人进行密切交谈。

4月16日中午12时30分，当七名居住者中的五人正在吃午饭时，一名身穿西式服装、年约30岁的中国人冲进屋内，用极其激动的声音喊道：“破脱！破脱！（被发现）”。居住者们饭未吃完便四处奔忙，收拾衣物，厨子看见两名男性用报纸包裹几包钞票，并各自将一把手枪放入口袋。厨子索要工资时，被告知等几天。其中一名男雇主随即拔出手枪，在厨子面前挥舞，禁止他向任何人报告

侦探对该房屋进行了搜查，发现了大量共产主义起源的印刷书籍，以及旅行和生活费用的清单。还发现了几名潜逃居住者的照片，但原件至今尚未被辨认出来。
侦探在屋内留守至晚上7时30分，随后听到后门有敲门声，开门后放入一名中国人，并立即对其进行了搜身。在其身上发现了：(1) 多份命令副本，显然由中共中央发布，取消原定于在上海举行的会议。该文件中提及第三国际。(2) 涉及代理助理警司（政治）和 D.S.U. Grubb 于4月15日前往戈登路1239号的信件。(3) 共产党员成员详情，显示年龄、籍贯、职业及过往活动。(4) 包含给党员指示及资金的信件。

pages.en:
Translation.
Brother Pay Ziens-雲泉
钦
Yesterday brother Ching told me that my suspension
was due to my impetuous attitude. Perhaps you have
misunderstood the whole affair. I have already written to
you through Kung Ying, but I will now further explain to
you inorder to defend myself.
Yu San always said to me: "This shop is situated in
a solitary place, so there is only little business. We must
remove otherwise we cannot improve our business."
I replied: "This small shop is originally intended for
our school. Business is done simply as a pretense. Our
shop cannot be compared with ordinary shops which do business
for profits. The solitary situation of our shop affords
us safety. Moreover this is a Communication Address for
outpost members, so it must not be removed."

Half a month ago, Yu San met some apprentices of the
book binding business in the shop. Afterwards he hurried
upstairs in a frightened manner and told me that we must remove
the shop. I told him that he could look after the food and
let his wife do the selling. Then it will be very safe.
Yu San said that he is an enemy of the master of the
apprentices. I said that he could ask the Central(Party!)
to give him some other work and appoint another man to
manage this shop. He was unwilling to do this. After that
day passed, he frequently came upstairs and told me lies.
(Then I believed him). said, "Last night there were 3 or
4 persons appearing to be labourers loitering in the vicinity
of the shop. They seemed to be on a watch. Today two
loafers stood opposite our shop for more than an hour."

I thought that if Yu San was telling the truth we must
devise plans to protect ourselves, because this shop is the
center of communication and its safety concerns the party(?)
generally.
At that time I explained the whole circumstances to you in person.
One day when Yu San came upstairs, I asked him whether it was
true that he saw the labourers and loafers watching the shop.
He hesitated in giving a definite answer. Afterwards, I
discovered that he exaggerated his story in an effort to remove
the shop and retain his position as manager. being afraid that he
would be transferred to do some wther work. Then I heard that
Yu San and Tseng San will exchange work. Yu San frequently
said to me that he and his wife were unwilling to xxxxxxxx
look after the shop. I said thathe and his wife could both
have the shop, but he seemed very displeased.
After the arrest of Wong Ching Tung, Yan told me to remove into
a Hotel. I did so accordingly. On the early morning of
6th I and Sien Vung decided to remove the furniture and
baggages to the new address. Sien Vung got up at dawn and went
to Yuen Dah to pack up things; Yu San's wife said to Sien Vung,
"Bad news. Detectives visited here yesterday. Don't take any
baggages. The detectives are outside. You go and tell Mr. Sung
not to return. Go quick." Sien Vung replied; "If detectives
are here, certainly I cannot go out. There are no documents here."
Sien Vung continued to pack up things, but Yu San's wife
repeatedly asked her to leave the shop. Sien Vung became
frightened and left. At 8.30 a.m. I hired 3 wheelbarrows
to take away the bagges from the shop. When I entered, Yu San
said "Go away quick. Tell Mr. Sung not to return here."
I believed her words so I left hurriedly without being able to
send away the wheelbarrow coolies. After returning to my
hotel, I began to realize that Yu San and his wife cannot be
trusted. Therefore I again hired rickshas(?) and was proceeding
to the shop when Yu San came and said to me "the house which
for which I recently paid rent has been discovered. We can't
remove them now". I did not believe him, so I decided
to stay there for one month.
pages.zh:
译文。
致云泉兄：
钦
昨日庆兄告知，我被停职是由于我态度急躁。或许你对整件事有所误解。我已通过孔英（音译）去信给你，但现再向你进一步解释，以作自辩。
余三常对我说：“本店地处偏僻，故生意清淡。我们必须搬迁，否则无法改善业务。”
我答道：“这家小店原本是为我们的学校而设。做生意只是掩人耳目。本店不能与那些以营利为目的的普通商店相比。本店地处偏僻，反而使我们安全。此外，这里是外围成员的联络地址，因此不可搬迁。”

半月前，余三在店里遇到几名装订业的学徒。随后他惊慌失措地跑上楼，告诉我必须搬迁店铺。我告诉他，他可以负责伙食，让他妻子负责售卖，这样就很安全。
余三说他是那些学徒师傅的仇家。我说他可以请求中央（党！）给他安排其他工作，并另派一人来管理此店。他不愿这样做。那天过后，他经常上楼对我撒谎。（当时我相信了他）。他说：“昨晚有三四个人看似劳工模样的人在店铺附近徘徊。他们似乎在监视。今天有两个闲汉在我们店对面站了一个多小时。”

我想，如果余三说的是真话，我们就必须 devise 计划保护自己，因为这家店是联络中心，其安危关系到全党（？）。
当时我当面向你解释了全部情况。有一天余三上楼时，我问他是否真的看到劳工和闲汉在监视店铺。他在给出确切回答时犹豫不决。后来，我发现他为了搬迁店铺并保住经理职位，夸大了事实，因为他害怕被调去做其他工作。随后我听说余三和曾三将交换工作。余三常对我说，他和他的妻子不愿意 xxxxxxxx 照看店铺。我说他和他的妻子都可以拥有这家店，但他似乎很不高兴。
黄景通被捕后，严叫我搬进一家旅馆。我照办了。6日清晨，我和先勇决定将家具和行李搬到新址。先勇黎明即起，前往元达打包物品；余三的妻子对先勇说：“坏消息。侦探昨天来过这里。不要拿任何行李。侦探在外面。你去告诉宋先生不要回来。快去。”先勇回答：“如果侦探在这里，我当然不能出去。这里没有文件。”
先勇继续打包，但余三的妻子反复要求她离开店铺。先勇感到害怕便离开了。上午8时30分，我雇了三辆独轮车从店里运走行李。当我进去时，余三说：“快走。告诉宋先生不要回这里。”
我相信了她的话，因此匆忙离开，未能打发走独轮车夫。回到旅馆后，我开始意识到余三及其妻子不可信任。因此我又雇了人力车（？）准备前往店铺，这时余三过来说：“我最近付了租金的那所房子已被发现。我们现在不能搬了。”我不相信他，所以决定在那里再住一个月。

(2)
Later during a conversation between Sien Vung and the landlady,
the latter said, "Terrible, The Communists. Last month when
some Communists were arrested in an upstairs room of a tailor
shop, the tenant of the house was also arrested. It is
terrible indeed."
At this time there was a sub tenant upstairs who appeared to
have seen the world and who was on friendly terms with me.
I inquired from him about the business of a subtenant living
downstairs like a labourer. He answered he never had
any communication with him. Shanghai is such a mixed up place
dotted all over with the organs of kidnappers and communists.
One easily slipped into their snares and got into great trouble.
I then felt much agitated as I doubted the safety of
the place. If I should have decided to remove in I might
cause blunders to hinder the progress of the school work.
I should then be held responsible. I did not know what to do
in the absence of introductions from you. At last I resolved
to leave the place and to get another safer place. I did not
receive your letter which told me not to remove. The house was
vacated and I stayed in a lodging house. You called while I
was away so I have not been able to report to you the particulars.
In the meantime there was some misunderstanding. Later I
endeavoured to find a suitable house, but was not able to get one.
When you left a note at my lodging house, I knew misunderstanding
existed. I wrote a letter and explained the circumstances.
I requested you and others to call me at my lodging house for
a personal interview. One week has
elapsed but you have never called. When I remained 4½ years in
school, I struggled hard everywhere. I shouldered responsibility
and was undaunted amongst dangers. My school mates commended
me for my results which could be verified. If you should
believe in me and be able to find a position for me in the
Communication Department or other place, you might put me on
probation. My wife will soon give birth to a child and
I can not say much to her. Otherwise please apply to the
Central to give me an allowance equivalent to month's
wages and to lend me some articles of furniture. I decide to
remove to-morrow. If you do not come to my place to-day you
cannot get my address in future. Nor I can get your communication
place. Our relation would be cut. I could then work as an
Individual Communist.
I earnestly hope that you will come to my place and have a talk
with me before 6 p.m. to-day, as I must remove to-morrow.
You are an experienced worker, but you have not considered
my case thoroughly.
You must come to-day and have a talk. I will remove to-
morrow. I do not know where to go. I have no money with me to
stay in a lodging house.
Your brother (Chang Ching Fu). 张庆孚

(2)
后来在先勇与房东太太的谈话中，后者说：“共产党真可怕。上个月裁缝店楼上的房间里逮捕了一些共产党人，该房的租户也被捕了。确实可怕。”
当时楼上有一位二房客，看似见过世面，且与我交好。我向他打听楼下那位看似劳工的二房客的底细。他回答说从未与其有过往来。上海是个鱼龙混杂的地方，遍布绑匪和共产党的机关。人们很容易落入他们的圈套而惹上大麻烦。
于是我因怀疑该地的安全而感到十分不安。如果我决定搬入，可能会造成失误，阻碍学校工作的进展。那样我就得承担责任。在没有你介绍信的情况下，我不知如何是好。最后我决定离开此地，另寻一个更安全的地方。我没有收到你告知我不要搬迁的信。房屋已腾空，我住进了寄宿处。你在我外出时来访，所以我未能向你报告详情。其间产生了一些误会。后来我努力寻找合适的房子，但未能找到。
当你在我寄宿处留下便条时，我知道存在误会。我写了一封信解释情况。我请求你和其他人到我寄宿处面谈。一周已过，但你从未前来。我在学校待了四年半，到处艰苦奋斗。我肩负责任，在危险中无所畏惧。我的同学们称赞我的成绩，这是可以查证的。如果你信任我，并能在联络部或其他地方为我谋得一职，你可以让我试用。我的妻子即将分娩，我无法对她多言。否则，请向中央申请给我相当于一个月工资的津贴，并借给我一些家具。我决定明天搬迁。如果你今天不来我处，你以后就无法得到我的地址。我也无法得到你的联络地点。我们的关系就会切断。那我就可以作为一名独立的共产主义者工作。
我恳切希望你今天下午6点前到我处与我谈谈，因为我明天必须搬迁。
你是一位有经验的工作者，但你没有彻底考虑我的情况。
你今天必须来谈谈。我明天就要搬迁。我不知道去哪里。我身边没有钱住寄宿处。
你的兄弟（张庆孚）。

SECRET & CONFIDENTIAL X

Brother Chia Sung (家声): 何英

At 9.45 a.m. I went to Ho Ying's place, and learnt that Brother Nung who went to his place last evening has been arrested by detectives, policemen and foreign inspectors. A thorough search has also been made by them and a certain record book, as Shih Hwa (仕華) said, was discovered. Shih Hwa instantly took out a diamond ring to bribe the interpreter, and the inspector, and spoke in German towards the foreign inspector, saying that this record book was his diary. As a result, this book has not been taken away.

This is being explained in response to questions put to me by Mr. Mu

This police inspector also asked whether Brother Nung's surname or name was Chang. Shih Hwa replied his surname was Li, and Brother Nung also declared that his surname was Li. The Police Inspector again asked how she knew Brother Nung. She (Shih Hwa) then replied that her husband and Brother Nung were schoolmates. The police-inspector again asked where her husband had gone. She replied her husband had gone to Nanking to seek employment.

Soon afterwards Ho Ying came in from outside and while he was going upstairs, Shih Hwa secretly made a sign with her hands towards him, who instantly withdrew from the house. He is still remaining outside daring not to return. Just I was writing here, Ho Ying entered in a great hurry, and said "Discovered, Discovered !" Then I asked him about the happening last night. He said at 7.30 p.m. yesterday, while he returned home, he saw a large crowd standing at the entrance to the alleyway, probably watching for the search of robbers. As soon as he opened the door with key he saw Shih Hwa standing upstairs, and making a sign with hands towards him. At the same time, he heard the sound of footsteps of several persons upstairs. So instantly he came out and then lingered along the Kiukiang Road and later he informed branches of what had happened. He also said that he had met and told Brother Mei (    ), this morning of this thing, so I would write

绝密 & 机密 X

家声兄：何英

上午9时45分，我前往何英处，得知昨晚去他那里的农兄已被侦探、警察和外籍巡捕逮捕。他们进行了彻底搜查，并如仕华所说，发现了一本记录簿。仕华立即拿出一枚钻戒贿赂翻译和巡捕，并用德语对外籍巡捕说，这本记录簿是他的日记。因此，这本书未被带走。

现就穆先生向我提出的问题作出上述解释。

这位警务督察还询问农兄的姓或名是否为张。仕华回答说他姓李，农兄也声明他姓李。警务督察又问她是如何认识农兄的。她（仕华）回答说，她的丈夫和农兄是同学。警务督察又问她的丈夫去了哪里。她回答说她的丈夫去南京求职了。

不久之后，何英从外面进来，当他正上楼时，仕华暗中向他打手势，他随即退出屋外。他仍留在外面，不敢返回。我正写到这里，何英匆匆进来，说道：“发现了，发现了！”于是我问他昨晚发生的事。他说昨天下午7时30分，他回家时，看到巷口聚集了一大群人，可能是在守候搜捕强盗。当他用钥匙开门时，看见仕华站在楼上，并向他打手势。同时，他听到楼上有几个人的脚步声。于是他立刻出来，随后在九江路徘徊，后来将发生的情况通知了各分部。他还说，今天早上他遇到了梅兄（    ），并将此事告诉了他，所以我现在不再写了

Brother Chia Sung (家声),

I returned home after having completed Fl/2 (?)
matter. Arriving at the alleyway, I saw a crowd at the
entrance to the alleyway. However, I entered the house, and
reaching the staircase, Shih Hwa (施華), knowing me coming up, made
sign to stop me. Besides I heard the footstep on the 1st
floor. I instantly came out and went by ricsha to the
Nan-Fang Hotel (南方旅馆) at Kiukiang Road, and notified
the man from Kiangsi. He was not there because he usually
visited my house twice a day. On my way back, I notified
Poo Tsing (步青), and asked him to tell you about it.
Subsequently I notified Tsuh Wen (文), Zai Sing
(在詞), Muir Ting (懋廷), 211 (?), Kao Fei (國非),
Hsia Ta Tsia (夏大坦), Ma Fei Peng (馬飛鵬), and nearly
all places which I know. I carried on warning until one
o'clock in the night. I slept that night in the Hotel.
I can not find any means to inform you and Pao Tsong of this
matter. Fearing that your men might go there and be arrested,
I asked Tsuh Wen (掇文) to wait for you on the street there
last night, and Ma etc to wait for you this morning. I
think you will not be in danger. Should the whole happening
turn out bad, indeed, a great loss will be incurred, Because
there is a registration book which contains names, occupation,
address, being written in plain words, and another book
containing the record of all persons recommended to various
other places is also written in plain words. Although I
have similar ones written in secret code, I have kept these
two for reference. Should these two be lost, the thing will
become worse. While I wrote here, Brother Mei came, and later
Pao Tsong arrived, and Ta Yien also came up and said that he
had visited my place, and learnt that Ta Kur (大□) had been
arrested --- the registration book has not been lost. This news
gives me much ease. Now the ways to remedy this case are as
follows:-

1. That urgent telegrams be despatched to various provinces
pages.zh:
译文

家声兄，

我处理完 Fl/2 (?) 事宜后回家。到达弄堂时，我看到弄堂口有一群人。然而，我还是进了屋，走到楼梯口时，施华知道我要上来，打手势让我停下。此外，我听到一楼有脚步声。我立刻出来，乘黄包车前往九江路的南方旅馆，并通知了那位江西人。他不在那里，因为他通常每天来我家两次。在回来的路上，我通知了步青，并请他告诉你这件事。
随后，我通知了文、在词、懋廷、211 (?)、国非、夏大坦、马飞鹏，以及我所知道的几乎所有地方。我一直进行警告直到深夜一点。当晚我住在旅馆里。
我找不到任何方法将此事通知你和宝宗。担心你的人可能会去那里而被捕，我昨晚让掇文在那里的街上等你，并让马等人今天早上等你。我想你应该不会有危险。如果整个事件结果糟糕，确实会造成巨大损失，因为有一本登记簿，上面用明文写着姓名、职业、地址，另一本记录所有被推荐到其他地方的人员的书也是用明文写的。虽然我有类似的用密码写的本子，但我保留这两本作为参考。如果这两本丢失，情况会变得更糟。我正写到这里，梅兄来了，随后宝宗到达，大年也上来说，他去过我家，得知大□已被捕——登记簿并未丢失。这个消息让我宽慰不少。现在补救此案的方案如下：-

1. 向各省发出紧急电报

REPORT ON Information received re.Communist s.

Made by D.S.McFarlane Forwarded by Jas. A. Adams Inspct.

Sir:
I beg to report that at about 2.15 p.m. April 16,
1928, a male Chinese named Lee Zung Sung(李顺生 )came to the
Armed
station and reported that there were Communists who lived in
a house situated at No.958 Connaught Road.
Inspector Adams and detectives proceeded to the
house but the occupants had already decamped.
From inquiries made it was ascertained that the
person who reported at the station had been employed as a cook
at this house for about one month and that the occupants, 3
male and 4 females had been there a little over a month. At
about 12 noon April 16,1928,a male Chinese dressed in foreign
clothes entered the house and told the four occupants who were
there that the Police had found out about them and that they
would have to hurry and make good their escape. The four peo-
ple thereupon gathered together some clothing and their money
and decamped. Before leaving the two men threatened the cook
with pistols, stating that they would shoot him if he reported
to the Police. They also burned a large number of papers. The
three other members of the household had left the house at
about 10 a.m. the same day, and have not yet returned. S.I.
The A.C.P.(Political) was informed and Det. Sergt.
Papp took charge of a number of books and papers of a Bolshevik
nature. These have been forwarded for translation.
A watch will be kept at the house for the next day
or so. Further enquiries proceeding.

(C.I.D.) Office Notes
File No. 9804
April 16, 1928.

At 9 pm., April 16, acting
on information I arrested Loo Yih Loong,
a leading Communist at No. 1239 Gordon
Rd. Loo was one of the principals in
the uprising on March 22, 1927 in
Shanghai & subsequently became a
member of the self-elected Communist
Municipality of Greater Shanghai.
On April 21, 1927, following the
anti-Communist movement of General
Yang Hu, a warrant was issued
for the arrest of Loo Yih Loong &
a reward of $1,000. promised by
Gen. Yang Hu for information leading
to the arrest. (File attached herewith)

Loo absconded & was not
heard of in Shanghai again until March
of this year. A second warrant & an
endorsement of the reward offered was
obtained from General Huang G. Hsu
but Loo again absconded to Hankow.
He returned on April 12 to Shanghai
but it was not until yesterday that
satisfactory arrangements could be made
with the informer to locate the wanted
man.

Loo appeared before the
Provisional Court on April 16 & was
remanded in custody pending the receipt
of a despatch from General Chien Da Ching
who now occupies the post of Defense
Commissioner.

1928年4月16日。

4月16日晚9时，根据情报，我在戈登路1239号逮捕了主要共产党人罗亦龙。罗是1927年3月22日上海起义的主要人物之一，随后成为自选的大上海共产党市政府的成员。
1927年4月21日，继杨虎将军的反共运动之后，签发了逮捕罗亦龙的逮捕令，杨虎将军承诺对提供导致逮捕的情报者给予1,000美元的赏金。（档案附后）

罗潜逃，直到今年三月在上海再次听到他的消息。从黄郛将军处获得了第二份逮捕令并对提供的赏金进行了背书，但罗再次潜逃至汉口。他于4月12日回到上海，但直到昨天才与线人做出令人满意的安排以定位这名通缉犯。

罗于4月16日出庭于临时法院，并被还押候审，等待现任防务专员钱大钧将军的公文到达。
